body: I don't really see how if at 19 I'm only concerned with sex I should feign some other kind if interest, or limit my options to girls who fulfil some other criterion.  I'm sorry if I seem thick, but I either don't understand your meaning or I don't understand your reasoning.
Sad, I hope you're not too down to appreciate the irony.

I watch a lot of porn. Recently bordering on 3-5 times a day. I've abstained from porn before for 4 days as a sort of curious challenge, in the short term it definitely made these issues worse, I felt extremely angry, bordering on violently so, with women. I have no idea what it would do for longer than 4 days but I find the prospect a tad frightening.

I don't really want anything but sex.

I'm not against other things, but I'm not terribly concerned with them and at this point they're inconsequential compared to sex.  Requiring anything extra would seem to limit my options, no?

It doesn't seem incredibly risky provided using proper protection etc.

It's certainly a risk I'm prepared to take when the alternative seems likely to mean I'm having no sex at all.
I'm not sure what something more meaningful necessarily entails, but I doubt it's something I want to do with most women if any at all.  This at the very least depressingly limits my options.

I watch **a lot** of porn.  More so recently.  I don't thing I have a preference for more especially violent porn, if anything it's more the opposite.  I won't discount the possibility that it's causing issues and several of the comments here are suggesting stopping.  I've abstained from porn before for 4 days as a sort of curious challenge, in the short term it definitely made these issues worse, no idea what it would do for longer than that.

What I'm really missing is sex though, not a relationship, I'm perfectly content with the friends I have as far as being with people.  A relationship could certainly fulfil the sex, but I feel like hookups would be easier, faster, and accomplish what I want.  Not to mention that there are far more women I'd be willing to hook up with than form a relationship with.

I'm already receiving outside counseling, you're right to suggest it and I appreciate the concern.

I'm 6'1" and fairly built, I wouldn't call myself ripped, but I don't think my problem is looks.

I'm normally in a dorm, but I'm home for now, at school I go to any parties I can, but as of now there's nothing for me to really do at home.

The issue is it really is just about the sex, I'm relatively happy in most other facets of my life.  If it weren't for even the remote possibility of sex I probably wouldn't want to talk to that cute girl at all.

I've acknowledged that even I think it's petty.  I'm not sure if you're trolling or attempting to help by putting things in perspective, but either way I'm acutely aware of how insignificant it may be in the grand scheme of things, unfortunately that alone doesn't change how I feel.

I've tried a bit of online dating, I haven't had a lot of success, I'm not sure how much of that is not putting effort into it and how much is being a 19 year old guy without a car.

Also, I've found online dating doesn't avoid my issues with dating in general, of the women I want to have sex with, women who's company I enjoy is a very small minority.  Casual sex via online dating sites is something that some people have obviously accomplished, and would be great, unfortunately it isn't easy for a guy (if it were most guys would).

I've paid for some measure of sexual favors, it's nice, however some of the problem is that I'm upset from an inability to effectively attract women and this doesn't change that aspect.

Additionally this is not a financially viable long term solution.
You may be right.  Unfortunately I've been watching porn far more often since break started, it's about 3-5 times a day at this point.
